<!-- Generated by `ims gen docs` from internal/authz/catalog.go. Do not edit: run `make docs-gen`. -->

70 permissions in 16 groups. Super-Admin bypasses every check. A tenant **Admin** holds the
tenant-level permissions; the **Developer** role holds the dashboard ones. Add a permission to
`internal/authz/catalog.go`, then run `ims permission:sync`.

## role

| Permission | Description | Seeded roles |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `role.view` | Can view role details | Admin |
| `role.view.all` | Can view all roles | Admin |
| `role.create` | Can create new roles | Admin |
| `role.internal.create` | Can create new internal roles | system |
| `role.update` | Can modify existing roles | Admin |
| `role.internal.update` | Can modify existing internal roles | system |
| `role.delete` | Can delete roles | Admin |
